title: Scanned input symbol under symbol lifting
statement: Let $e: ool	o	ext{Γ}$ be an injective map, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. The symbol scanned by the input head after lifting $c$ through $e$ is the image under $e$ of the symbol scanned by $c$, with absence of a scanned symbol preserved.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from Boolean symbols to symbols in Γ
